name: Pumpkling King
description: The Pumpkling King is a hefty, scarred pumpkling bearing a crown and scepter or authority which he uses to command both his minions and enemies. Though rough and vulgar like the other pumpklings, he has a does his best to conduct himself in a regal manner.

actions.name: Ray of Command
actions.description:
The pumpkling king shoots a ray out of his scepter that forces a creature within 10 units to use their reaction, if they have it, to do one of the following, determined by a 1d4:
1>dance in place and make a performance check higher than 9 or take 3d4 psychic damage.
2>fall prone
3>move up to their total movement speed in a random direction
4>spin around in circles and make a concentration check of 9 or higher or become dazed

actions.name: Ray of Mindwrack
actions.description: The pumpkling king shoots a ray out of his scepter at a creature within 10 units, dealing psychic damage.

actions.name: Cannibalize
actions.description: In response to another pumpkling reaching 0 health within 4 units, the pumpkling moves towards them and rapidly eats their remains, gaining 2d6 health.

actions.name: Ray of Redirection
actions.description: In response to a creature within 10 units target it with a single target ray or projectile attack, the pumpkling king attempts to redirect it at another creature within 10 units. If the pumpkling king’s attack check for redirecting the ray is higher than the original attack check, the attack is successfully redirected using the new roll.

actions.name: Regal Rollout
actions.description: The pumpkling king tucks in his limbs and starts rolling, gaining +2 movement speed on his next move this turn. At the end of his next move, all adjacent creatures must make a contested shove check; failure results in taking 1d6 physical damage per unit the pumpkling king traveled.

actions.name: King's Guard
actions.description: The pumpkling king calls out to all allies within 10 units and beckons them to protect him. Any allied creature that still has it's reaction immediately uses it to move up to their full movement speed towards the pumpkling king.

traits.name: Soft Rind
traits.description: The pumpkling king has a very soft outer shell causing it to gain the bleeding condition whenever it takes physical damage.
